description: Office build-out permits, the Permits tab of app.fundz.net/office-expansions: commercial tenant build-out, alteration and new-building permits from city records in New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Boston, San Francisco and Seattle, with the named tenant (private and public companies), address, estimated build-out cost, permit status and a Fundz company link when matched. A permit is usually pulled 30 to 90 days after a lease is signed, so it is an early sign a company is adding space and about to hire. By default only permits that name a tenant or owner-occupier, cost $250K or more, and are not food, retail or salon fit-outs or certificates of occupancy (finished work) are returned; set min_cost, include_consumer or include_completed to widen. Use together with search_office_expansions (SEC 8-K leases, public companies, any geography) for the full expansion picture. Filter by city, state, company, work type, minimum cost and filing date. Page through every match with page; use since to get only permits filed on or after a date.

city.description: One or more of NYC, SF, LA, CHI, BOS, SEA or the city name, comma-separated. Default: all six.

company_name.description: Tenant, owner or applicant name (partial, case-insensitive)

days.description: Only permits filed in the last N days (default 60)

include_completed.description: Also return certificates of occupancy (the work is finished, not starting). Default false.

include_consumer.description: Also return cafe, restaurant, retail, salon, gym and hotel fit-outs and food-service vendors. Default false: a coffee shop build-out is not a hiring signal.

include_unnamed.description: Also return permits that name no tenant (landlord or developer work). Default false.

matched_only.description: Only permits matched to a Fundz company profile

min_cost.description: Minimum estimated build-out cost in USD. Default 250000 (smaller permits are rarely an expansion signal); set 0 or 1 to see every size. Not applied by default when company_name is given.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1). The reply ends with the total and next_page when there are more.

since.description: Only permits filed on or after this ISO date, e.g. "2026-10-01". Overrides days.

state.description: US state 2-letter code(s), comma-separated, e.g. "NY, MA"

work_type.description: One or more of: tenant_improvement, new_building, alteration, fitout, other (comma-separated)

name: search_office_permits
title: Search office build-out permits
